verdict.rationale: Inside the product, Query Assistant uses AI to turn natural-language questions into Honeycomb queries, and Canvas investigations accept skills that add instructions or context, which points to an in-product AI investigation surface. However, the evidence never directly shows Honeycomb surfacing AI-generated insights or suggestions about the data itself. The MCP-based diagnosis and optimization suggestions run in external agents, not inside the product, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented in-product AI-generated insights/findings from data, documented in-product suggestions or recommendations, details of what Canvas investigations produce, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Query Assistant is a feature that generates Honeycomb queries based on your natural language query (NLQ) input.
Use skills to add instructions or context to your Canvas investigations.
